content: A husband argued that a house co-signed in both names was actually his personal property because he used settlement money from a pre-marital accident to buy it,. The court addressed the concept of "indirect donation" in the context of Article 177,. The interpretive problem was whether the co-titularity in the deed overrode the personal origin of the funds. The court ruled that by co-signing without the required Article 179 declaration, the husband manifested an intent to donate half the property's value to his wife, finalizing its status as a joint asset.
